purpose: Indenter can access only own booking status and history.
preconditions: Authorized Indenter and one own plus one foreign booking.
expected_result: Own booking status/history is returned; foreign row is not accessible.

purpose: Authorized Indenter creates a valid Pending booking.
preconditions: Authorized Indenter and valid stay data.
expected_result: 201 response and Pending status; successful data capture.

purpose: Caretaker direct rejection and forwarding route correctly.
action_or_input: Review as reject and forward in separate cases.
expected_result: Reject produces Rejected; forward produces Forwarded.

purpose: Offline booking uses the normal route.
expected_result: Booking is flagged offline and remains subject to availability/routing.

purpose: Pre-arrival modification request is recordable.
expected_result: Modification request is created; billing remains unchanged until confirmed.

purpose: Cancellation charge schedule and confirmation.
preconditions: Bookings at 7+, 1-6 and same-day cancellation offsets.
expected_result: 0%, 25%, and 50% of one-day room rent respectively; billing adjusts only after confirmation.

purpose: Room allotment requires approval.
expected_result: Approved booking can be allotted; Pending booking refusal changes nothing.

purpose: Check-in/out and stay exceptions are recorded.
action_or_input: Run check-in, check-out and stay scan.
expected_result: Times are recorded and no-show/overstay alerts are raised under stated conditions.

purpose: Effective category tariffs are selected without changing history.
preconditions: Category/occupancy tariffs at distinct effective dates.
action_or_input: Generate bills before and after a tariff change.
expected_result: Bill uses applicable recorded tariff and historical total remains immutable.

purpose: Guest meal booking reflects the stay and billing.
preconditions: Guest with active VH stay and meal tariff.
action_or_input: Record breakfast, lunch, dinner and tea/milk.
expected_result: Only stated options are accepted and linked meal charges appear in billing.

purpose: Bill, offline settlement and verification are preserved.
action_or_input: Generate, settle offline in cash, and verify bill.
expected_result: Bill snapshot is generated; settlement and verification are recorded, with immutable history.

purpose: Inventory below threshold generates an alert.
preconditions: Inventory item below and at threshold.
expected_result: Below-threshold condition generates the alert; threshold equality does not.

purpose: In-Charge reviews replenishment.
expected_result: The specified decision and audit timestamp are recorded.

purpose: Lifecycle and event notifications are triggered.
expected_result: Outbox records are created; no system actor is modeled.

purpose: In-Charge reports cover stated summaries.
action_or_input: Request booking, occupancy, billing and inventory usage reports.
expected_result: Each report returns its corresponding authoritative summary.

purpose: Caretaker reports cover stated operational logs.
action_or_input: Request daily occupancy, arrivals/departures, pending and exceptions.
expected_result: Each report or log reflects the corresponding records.

purpose: Only one active holder exists for each operational role.
action_or_input: Assign Caretaker and In-Charge time-bound duty.
expected_result: Exactly one active holder per role and reassignment is effective immediately.

purpose: Visitor and system actor boundaries are preserved.
preconditions: Visitor identity and system task context.
expected_result: No visitor login or primary system actor is introduced; refusal or no route.

purpose: Role assignment stays VH-specific.
preconditions: VH operational roles and platform account records.
expected_result: No platform-level account or HR authority is assigned.

purpose: Booking, allotment, stay, bill and inventory records remain auditable.
preconditions: A complete lifecycle with audit events.
expected_result: Each represented change has an attributable audit record.

purpose: Role-bounded access and tariff/integrity boundaries hold.
preconditions: Configured tariffs and users of different roles.
action_or_input: Attempt cross-role and unsupported price operations.
expected_result: Unauthorized or unsupported operations are refused without change.
